scene_manager_scope.transition_handling: Branding -> menu -> first_playable_slice -> result/rematch. Each scene owns and releases its VDP, CRAM, sprite and audio resources; stage preload precedes the fight state. Existing menu routing still needs runtime verification.

input_abstraction_scope.abstraction_layer: SGDK joypad snapshot consumed once per fight tick; separate held/pressed/released semantics are required for menu and fighter commands

camera_runtime_scope.runtime_owner: mg_fight camera update and stage renderer; canonical C source in the shared converter runtime
camera_runtime_scope.culling_owner: mg_fight sprite/projectile visibility; physics remains active outside view

transitions.trigger: all scene assets and initial scroll tables are ready
super sequence and CRAM restore complete
rematch selected and scene resources are reset

memory_pool_map.lifecycle: static for a round; sheets change through fixed slots and measured fallback allocation

memory_pool_map.owner: two MgPlayer projectile arrays; MG_MAX_PROJ=4 per player
memory_pool_map.lifecycle: fixed pool; released on collision, round reset or owner cleanup
fixed pool; current compile-time limit, pressure must be measured with the stage

vblank_dma_ownership.vblank_owner: SGDK frame loop and VBlank DMA queue; scene owner schedules persistent buffers before VBlank
dma_owners: fight renderer for palette and effect updates
BG_A/B scroll table owner after stage renderer is integrated
vblank_dma_ownership.safety_pattern: Queue only from persistent/static buffers; never issue DMA outside VBlank. Large stage loads occur before fight input; per-frame H-scroll and animation updates receive a measured byte budget.

channel_owners: PSG cues where the existing driver supports them

technique_selection.selection_rationale: The measured Suzaku source has three front layers that align to exact vertical bands, making per-line parallax a testable two-plane route. Stage patterns still exceed measured capacity, BG_B contains overlapping deltas, and palette ownership is unresolved; selection authorizes investigation and measured implementation, not production promotion.
technique_selection.fallback_strategy: Keep current fight bounds and plane-level background scroll if the banded view, DMA or camera budget fails. Redesign source-derived composition and palette before considering streaming; preserve the static neutral stage until a hash-bound ROM passes.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Keep stage and fighter resources stable while the player enters, fights and triggers a super.
application_plan.visual_or_audio_role: Load complete scene assets safely and update small tables during VBlank.
application_plan.budget_evidence: DMA bytes per preload and worst fight frame remain unmeasured.
application_plan.fallback: Use preload-only transfers and remove per-frame updates until a safe queue budget is proven.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Keep both fighters framed while preserving screen bounds and floor contact at both corners.
application_plan.visual_or_audio_role: Pan authored depth at integer pixel positions and keep the HUD fixed.
application_plan.budget_evidence: Camera contract exists; proposed world 768/camera 0..448 is not integrated or captured.
application_plan.fallback: Retain the current 640-pixel world and midpoint camera until corner replay proves the expanded route.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Preserve the three source speeds of the roof, floor and front lip without adding a third scrolling plane.
application_plan.visual_or_audio_role: Assign BG_A offsets by the measured vertical bands and leave WINDOW/HUD screen-fixed.
application_plan.budget_evidence: Source bands and deltas are measured; H-scroll DMA, seam and live viewport costs are not.
application_plan.fallback: Use one declared BG_A plane scroll compromise and simplify the source composition if the line table misses budget.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Keep floor contact, castle silhouette, occlusion and camera-edge readability coherent in a full fight.
application_plan.visual_or_audio_role: Compose source-derived BG_A/BG_B maps and measure exact tile reuse and visible residency.
application_plan.budget_evidence: Source pattern report gives 700 front and 1021 back patterns after exact reuse; these are not ResComp or viewport counts.
application_plan.fallback: Cut/recompose authored details under visual review before reducing sprite allocation or hiding required animation.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Prevent stage, HUD, portraits, fighter flash and super background from corrupting one another's colors.
application_plan.visual_or_audio_role: Give CRAM writes declared owners and restore exact words on state exit.
application_plan.budget_evidence: Current CRAM map exposes PAL0 HUD/stage/super conflicts and PAL3 FX ownership; route decision remains open.
application_plan.fallback: Keep the stage out of production resources until the consumer swap contract and color review pass.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Support the fight loop, round changes and impact/super feedback without stopping music.
application_plan.visual_or_audio_role: Use authored FM/PSG/XGM2 assets with explicit cue priority and a stable loop.
application_plan.budget_evidence: Driver presence is known; fight music, final loop, mix and worst-case audio CPU remain unaudited.
application_plan.fallback: Use the existing driver and reduce simultaneous cues before considering a custom PCM path.

rejected_or_deferred.reason: Streaming reduces the resident world set but cannot reduce patterns simultaneously visible if the chosen viewport still exceeds the stage region.
rejected_or_deferred.reconsideration_gate: Reconsider only after the real banded viewport report identifies whether camera-window residency is the remaining cost.

risk_mitigation_table.risk: Banded source stage remains over the available VRAM estimate.
risk_mitigation_table.mitigation: Measure actual ResComp and simultaneous tile patterns per camera window; redesign source-derived art before changing the fighter pool.

risk_mitigation_table.risk: PAL0 stage/HUD/super and PAL1/PAL2 fighter flash share consumers.
risk_mitigation_table.mitigation: Resolve the CRAM route in the existing B1 decision record and prove byte-exact restore in a same-SHA ROM.

risk_mitigation_table.risk: Three animated events may be dropped or mistimed during conversion.
risk_mitigation_table.mitigation: Preserve AIR frame timing and BGCtrl windows; add a source-referenced ROM event capture.

risk_mitigation_table.risk: World expansion can change push, command distance and corner behavior.
risk_mitigation_table.mitigation: Replay camera center, corners, reversal, push, jump and super states before accepting world bounds.
